links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level, Flesch Reading Ease) of LLM bladder cancer patient education responses
links.effect: Significant difference in readability among LLMs (p < 0.001); ChatGPT-4 gave the most college-level responses, which were the most challenging to read.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 providing the most college-level responses, though these were the most challenging to read

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability of ChatGPT and Gemini responses to bladder cancer patient education questions using urologist expert ratings.
